name: Microsoft 365
summary: Outlook mail and calendar, OneDrive, contacts, To Do and OneNote in your Microsoft account, with a built-in Microsoft sign-in

transports.description: Microsoft 365 wrapper (stdio): Softeria's server with a sign-in that completes under dmcp.

configurableProperties.label: Tool presets
configurableProperties.description: Comma-separated Softeria presets to expose: mail, calendar, files, contacts, tasks, onenote, excel, search, personal, or all. More presets means more tools and wider sign-in permissions; sign in again after changing it.

configurableProperties.label: Read-only
configurableProperties.description: true to start the server read-only: every tool that would change, send or delete is disabled. Turning it off asks Microsoft for write permissions you have not approved yet, so sign in again after changing it.

configurableProperties.label: Work account mode
configurableProperties.description: true for a work or school account. Its extra tools (Teams, SharePoint, shared mailboxes) are not offered yet: none has been reviewed (see withheldTools). Personal Microsoft accounts leave it off. Sign in again after changing it.

configurableProperties.label: Microsoft Entra app client id
configurableProperties.description: Optional. Your own Entra app registration's public client id, for organisations that do not allow Softeria's app. Public, not a secret.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Sign in to Microsoft 365 (Outlook mail, calendar, OneDrive and more). Starts Microsoft's device sign-in: prints a link and a short code, opens the browser, and waits until the user approves. Blocks until approved, declined or expired, so dispatch it as a concurrent task with a reminder, and tell the user the link and code when they show up in the output. Does nothing if already signed in, unless force is true. Returns who signed in; tokens are never returned.

checks: upstream: @softeria/ms-365-mcp-server 0.166.0, MIT, npm package with SLSA provenance built from commit 675b82198701b9565ab3cdd836d1a2c7aac4f8c9 (the v0.166.0 tag)
install: npm ci from the committed package-lock.json (211 packages, each verified by sha512), --ignore-scripts, optional packages (keytar, Azure Key Vault) omitted
wrapper: first-party stdlib Python in this repository; shared sign-in helper vendored from servers/_lib, identical copy enforced by the PR gate
sign-in: Softeria's own device-code login, run as one blocking call; the link must be on a Microsoft sign-in host or it is refused; the browser opener is detached from the MCP wire
tokens: Softeria's MSAL cache is kept through cache_store.py in the OS keyring (secret-tool) or an owner-only file; tokens never appear in a tool result
withheld: graph-batch, the container deletes (calendar, mail folder, contact folder, planner bucket, To Do list) and webhook subscription creation are hidden and refused by the wrapper
trust.notes: Defaults to the mail and calendar presets (83 tools). MS365_PRESET widens it; every tool Softeria exposes outside work mode is classified here (187). Work-mode tools (Teams, SharePoint) are not declared individually, so JARVIS gates them at elevated or above. Microsoft's official Work IQ servers (agent365) are the door for tenants with a Copilot licence and admin consent; they are documented in #91, not required.
trust.securityNotes: The widest blast radius in the registry: mail, calendar and files in the user's account. Reads are elevated (mail and documents carry text anyone can send); anything that sends, notifies attendees, shares, forwards, changes permissions or rules, overwrites, deletes or touches local files is dangerous. Sign-in goes through Softeria's multi-tenant Entra app unless MS365_MCP_CLIENT_ID names your own.
